purpose: Issue and freeze testable early forecasts using depth charts and projected roles without waiting for final starters

early_mode_amendments.G08: Use current sourced availability and model explicit uncertainty; no final-clearance wait
early_mode_amendments.G09: Use source-stamped projected/depth roles and minute distributions; no confirmed-starter wait
early_mode_amendments.G60: Freeze the early snapshot; later information creates a new immutable revision, never a prerequisite for this forecast

blind: Independent pooled lagged ridge with at least 3 real target appearances and 100 real chronological training rows
missing_non_target_reserve_history: Explicit observed-peer prior, zero target logs retained, uncertainty and sensitivity recorded
missing_target_history: Never invent games; require genuine supported target features or show an exact blocker
direction: Mandatory OVER or UNDER on successfully executed supported props
test_readiness: FORWARD_TEST_READY when the prediction is actually frozen before tipoff
original_rules_and_receipts: Preserved; this is a separate early-mode amendment
